meta.title: Steward · long-lived engineering team
meta.description: Multi-role engineering team for DSH: the lead agent acts as Tech Lead, decomposes the request into a task DAG and dispatches specialist subagents (pm / architect / backend-dev / frontend-dev / qa-engineer / browser-tester / reviewer), with a plan approval gate, bug track, maintenance loop and trusted-change gates; the seven roles are DSH Agent Presets, with model and reasoning effort configured in Settings → Steward.
